'''2009 Coruscant Regionals Jarad Konsker LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jarad Konsker]] at [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]].

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
